mapping.author: m8-mapper-opus
mapping.draft_py:
SELF = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1), mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE, filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),))
# This creature enters with four +1/+1 counters on it.  (M21 Malefic Scythe's EtBState form)
enters_with = EtBState(initial_counters=((CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1, QConst(value=4)),))
# {2}{G}{G}: Put X +1/+1 counters on this creature, where X is its power.
# "its power" is the source's power as the ability resolves: QProp('source', POWER).
double_up = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(
        CostManaColor(color='G', amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaColor(color='G', amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=2)),
    )),
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QProp(referent='source', field=QPropField.POWER),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': SELF,
    }),
)
abilities = [enters_with, double_up, *compiled]

clauses.clause: This creature enters with four +1/+1 counters on it.
{2}{G}{G}: Put X +1/+1 counters on this creature, where X is its power.

mapping.notes: M8 mapper. Probe gap: the probe puts a 0/0 that enters with counters on the battlefield as 'not a creature' (M21 Wildwood Scourge too), so ability [1] is never probed; the packs play it. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/heroes_bane_*.json.
